title: ST131Finder
description:
A single-file browser tool that assigns Escherichia coli ST131 clade by in silico PCR without relying on the ybbW marker, reports every isolate under all five published ST131 nomenclatures, and returns MLST, fimH, O:H serotype, QRDR genotype and acquired resistance genes in the same pass. All computation runs in the browser; sequence data never leaves the operator's machine.

Version 1.3.0 derives the Price et al. (2013) label from the clade assignment rather than from the ybbW marker, so that clade C2 isolates lacking the ybbW SNP are still reported as H30Rx.
